reply.text:
Fifteen pounds in a week isn't something I'll help you chase. The only ways to get there are crash dieting or dropping water, and both are unsafe and tend to leave you flat and drained on the day itself. This is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can speak to your situation.

What I can help with is training. A few well-built sessions this week can improve how you carry yourself and feel in the clothes, and I'm glad to set that up whenever you're ready. Congratulations, by the way.
